d:
The Rockets defeated the Nuggets, 110-100 tonight in Houston. Kevin Durant finished with a team-high 23 points along with 12 rebounds and 8 assists for the Rockets, while Alperen Sengun tallied 20 points, 11 rebounds and 8 assists in the game. Jamal Murray recorded 38 points, 5 three pointers and 2 rebounds. The Rockets improve their record to 8-3 with the win, while the Nuggets fall to 5-4 for the season.
